title: Shared Test Infrastructure Layer
description: Build shared test infrastructure to support all subsequent testing tasks: extend existing setup.ts with complete VS Code API coverage, create 6 mock factory modules (vscode, ai-providers, scm-providers, configuration, logger, notification), extract createMockContext() to shared location, and create 3 data fixture modules (diff-samples, commit-messages, config-states). This is the prerequisite for all other tasks.

3 fixture modules created: [diff-samples.ts, commit-messages.ts, config-states.ts] — verify by ls src/__tests__/fixtures/*.ts | wc -l = 3
2 helper modules created: [mock-context.ts, di-helpers.ts] — verify by ls src/__tests__/helpers/*.ts | wc -l >= 2
setup.ts covers all missing VS Code API surfaces (extensions, EventEmitter, Disposable, CancellationTokenSource, etc.)

rationale.why: All 6 features depend on shared mock factories, fixtures, and helpers. Building this first eliminates 30-40% code duplication across subsequent tasks.
rationale.approach: Extend existing setup.ts additively (no breaking changes), create new mock/fixture/helper directories following vi.mock + vi.hoisted patterns from existing tests

risks.mitigation: Additive-only changes; run full test suite after modification
